d: Short, messy ash-blonde hair with choppy bangs and a youthful, adolescent face. The eyes are a vibrant lime green with a gentle expression. A slender build wearing a white ruffled dress with a brown leather corset, paired with a long, flowing purple and black feathered cloak, black fingerless gloves, and black lace-up boots with white trim. Signature details include a white headpiece with a feather, a black staff topped with a large grey owl, and several small, glowing blue spectral birds floating nearby.
